- **Origin:** Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c7 P63](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0063)</sub>

## Appearance

Captain Saul possessed a tall and somewhat awkward form that implied immense endurance and power. His hair was a thick, iron-gray mane hanging down to his shoulders. He had a bronzed, closely shaved, and heavily furrowed face, along with deep-set, exceptionally blue eyes that occasionally twinged with dreams or gazed out toward the sea.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014)_

## Personality

Captain Saul was an unpretentious, pure-hearted, and high-souled man who retained an everlasting youth within his heart. He possessed a constant good humor and a fervent adoration for beauty in every form. Known for his calm and philosophical demeanor, he enjoyed long discussions on deep topics and was notorious for affectionately interfering in matters to help others. He was an engaging, natural narrator who delighted in sharing stories and music.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c8 P61](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0061), [v4 c9 P5](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0005), [v4 c9 P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038), [v4 c9 P49](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0049), [v4 c14 P3](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0003), [v4 c17 P16](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0016), [v4 c17 P18](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0018)_

## History

Captain Saul grew up in a seafaring family and befriended the local schoolmaster John Tremayne during his youth, developing an early love for poetry and stories. Driven by his nature, he ran off to sea as a young man and spent the next several decades exploring the world as a ship captain. Fifty years before his later years, he suffered the loss of his beloved Margaret, who vanished in a thundersquall. In his travels, he encountered and brought back Laurence Vane from Havana, assuming him to be Rufus Vane. Upon retiring from his life at sea to the lighthouse at Seven Gulls Point, he spent his winters at the Point with his rescued pet cat, the First Mate. He maintained warm friendships with local residents like Elizabeth Russell, Nell Harcourt, Hugh Carrow, and Ambrose Kerr, often entertaining them with fiddle music, tales, and deep conversations by his fireplace. Later in life, he collaborated with Adrian Treleaven to publish his memories in a volume titled The Life-Book of Captain Saul. Before his death at age seventy-six, he willed his global collection of oddities to Little Kit and secured a loving home for the First Mate with Nell.

_Sources: [v4 c7 P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005), [v4 c7 P48](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0048), [v4 c8 P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063), [v4 c9 P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c14 P2](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0002), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c17 P1](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0001), [v4 c20 P16](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0016), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 c35 P39](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0039), [v4 c39 P5](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0005), [v4 c39 P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028), [v5 c6 P29](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0029)_
